reuse.why: Extends the existing assertBankAccountLinkable, but writes a new releaseAccountLinks instead of extracting the local-detach update from unlinkAccount and sharing it.

duplication.why: releaseAccountLinks copies unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount field-clearing block verbatim, and the replaced-ids/release wiring is repeated in all six provider link functions.

placement.why: The logic stays in accounts/app.ts next to the link guard, though an assert function that now also returns ids to act on blurs its role.

scope.why: Only the link parameter type, the guard, a release helper and the six link handlers change.

maintainability.why: Readable, but 'what unlinking clears' now lives in two places that can drift, and every provider must remember to call release after the bank lookup.

bypasses_abstraction.where: releaseAccountLinks in server/accounts/app.ts re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount instead of sharing it with the unlink action.

disguised_duplication.where: releaseAccountLinks is unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount clearing block moved under a new name and wrapped in a loop rather than extracted and shared.
